devdoc.details: The lending pool is also a ERC20 token. This token always represents the total balance of the lending pool against the underlying asset. These ERC20 tokens represent an IOU for the asset. Tokens should only be held by the lending pool tranches and the lending pool itself. Balance of each tranche represents its asset value. Tokens held by the lending pool represent the first loss capital asset value. When interests are applied, the lending pool mints additional tokens to the tranches. When a loss is reported, the lending pool burns tokens from itself and the tranches. New deposits mint new tokens to the tranches. Withdrawals burn tokens from the tranches and the lending pool and transfer asset of the same amount back to the user.

Initialized(uint64).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

acceptDeposit(address,address,uint256).details: This function is called by the pending pool. Transfers the assets from the pending pool to the lending pool. Mints the lending pool token. Mints tranche shares to the user.

params.acceptedAmount: The amount of the deposit that is accepted.
params.tranche: The tranche address the deposit is accepted to.

acceptWithdrawal(address,address,uint256.details: This function is called by the pending pool. Burns tranche shares from the user. Burns the lending pool token. Transfers the assets from the tranche to the user.

params.acceptedShares: The amount of the withdrawal that is accepted.

returns.assetAmount: The amount of the underlying asset that is withdrawn and transferred to the user.

applyInterests(uint256).details: This function is called by the clearing coordinator. Applies the interests to the lending pool tranches. Mints the lending pool tokens to the tranches. Increases the owed amount by the interest amount.

params.epoch: The epoch number for which the interests are applied.

approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. NOTE: If `value` is the maximum `uint256`, the allowance is not updated on `transferFrom`. This is semantically equivalent to an infinite approval. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

returns._0: The available funds of the lending pool in the underlying asset.

calculateMaximumLossAmount().details: Returns the first loss capita amount plus the sum of the maximum loss amount of each tranche. The loss amount can't be greater than the user owed amount. If it is, returns the user owed amount.

returns.maximumLossAmount: The maximum loss amount of the lending pool that can be reported.

returns.claimedAmount: The amount of the loss that is claimed.

returns._0: The clearing configuration of the lending pool.
Decimals of the lending pool token.

depositFirstLossCapital(uint256).details: Transfers the assets to the lending pool. Mints the lending pool token to itself.

params.amount: The amount of the first loss capital to deposit.

drawFunds(uint256).details: Decrease the desired draw amount by the draw amount. Called by the clearing coordinator.

forceImmediateWithdrawal(address,address.details: Burns tranche shares from the user. Burns the lending pool token. Transfers the assets from the tranche to the user.

params.sharesToWithdraw: The amount of the shares to withdraw.

returns.assetAmount: The amount of the underlying asset that is withdrawn and transferred to the user.

params.lendingPoolInfo_: Lending pool info containing other addresses and configuration.

returns._0: Whether the address is a tranche of this lending pool.

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

payOwedFees().details: Tries to repay fees from the available balance. Called by the clearing coordinator at the end of the clearing.

params.amount: The amount of the loss to repay.

repayOwedFunds(uint256).details: First we repay the owed fees, then we repay the user owed amount.

reportLoss(uint256,bool).details: Applies the loss first to the first loss capital. If there is no more first loss capital, the loss is applied to the tranches in order from the junior to the senior. Burns tranche shares if needed. Burns the lending pool token in te amount of the loss.

params.doMintLossTokens: If true, mints loss tokens to all the users.
params.lossAmount: The amount of the loss. Shouldn't be more than the maximum loss amount.

stop().details: Stops the lending pool. Can only be stopped if all owed amounts are repaid. After stopping the lending pool, the lending pool can't accept new deposits. The pool can't be resumed after stopping. Sets the interest rates of the tranches to zero.

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `to` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `value`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. This is not required by the EIP. See the note at the beginning of {ERC20}. NOTE: Does not update the allowance if the current allowance is the maximum `uint256`. Requirements: - `from` and `to` cannot be the zero address. - `from` must have a balance of at least `value`. - the caller must have allowance for ``from``'s tokens of at least `value`.

updateTrancheDesiredRatios(uint256[]).details: The sum of the ratios should be 100%.

params.ratios: The desired ratios of the tranches.

updateTrancheInterestRate(address,uint25.details: The interest rate is updated for the future epoch depending on the epoch delay. _futureTrancheInterests should always have at least one element.

params.epochDelay: The epoch delay for the interest rate change.

returns.userPoolBalance: Total balance of the lending pool in the underlying asset.

withdrawFirstLossCapital(uint256,address.details: Can only be called once lending pool is stopped. Transfers the assets to the first loss capital receiver. Burns the lending pool token.

params.withdrawAddress: The address to withdraw the first loss capital to.
params.withdrawAmount: The amount of the first loss capital to withdraw.

_futureTrancheInterests.details: The array should always have at least one element after initialization.
